sloka: शूलमुद्गरखड्गैश्च जघ्नुः प्रासैश्च शक्तिभिः।अन्योन्यं पातयामासुः परस्परजयैषिणः ।। ६.६९.५४ ।।
transliteration: śūlamudgarakhaḍgaiśca jaghnuḥ prāsaiśca śaktibhiḥ।anyonyaṁ pātayāmāsuḥ parasparajayaiṣiṇaḥ ।। 6.69.54 ।।

translations.english: Then in a short while the battlefield was covered with blood and rocks and swords used by the monkeys and Rakshasas.
